notes.title: Patch #3 The Blast Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Just a quick patch that will fix a couple of issues that we saw popping yesterday! We hope that your saves won't be deleted this time and we are really sorry if it happens again. 

- Fix the dialogues of Blast Professor (again...)
- Fix the collision and triggers of the MagnaVex TV
- Fix Windows 7 version

We are really close to 10K units "sold" and so we want to thank you again for your support <3 We hope that Evo\Wave brought you fun and joy and that it will continue to do so!

The Evo\Wave Team

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone ! Today we bring you news and a patch for Evo\Wave ! 

Firstly, we want to thank you for your outstanding support for our game ! As some of you know, we are a team of students and this is our final project so it means alot for us that so many people like our game and also leave reviews, sending us messages and making videos or speedrun ! 

We also want to remind you that the soundtrack of Evo\Wave is available for free on Steam and on YouTube !! So if you liked the multiple songs of the game you can get them for free !!

We hope that with this update the Evo\Core will be more powerful and will help you in your fight against the evil MagnaVex !!

Fixes :

Fixing an issue with the power coming back offline in the level 2
Fixing the “Ok Boomer” achievement 
Improvement on the UI to make it more user friendly
Fixing duplicating Facts sheets and chips in the level 3
Fixing some dialogue issue with Bl4st Pr0fessor
Fixing some minor sound and visual bugs

Thank you all again from the bottom of our hearts - The Evo\Wave Team

notes.title: Announcing the third level of Evo\Wave!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Last week we presented to you Park 64, the level 2 of Evo\Wave! This week we will send you to a new era of video games! The Beach!

After LAI-6 found the peripherals after restoring the power in Park 64, she'll need to find the peripheral that was hidden in this level. With a new and really useful power-up, she will be able to make her way to one of the little islands and find the new peripheral!

You will be able to play level 3 when the game is released for FREE on Steam on March 12, 2021! If you haven't already done so, feel free to wishlist the game to help us get referenced on Steam!

notes.title: Announcing the first level of Evo\Wave !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

To prepare you for your adventures in the colourful world of Evo\Wave, we're going to introduce you to the different levels that LAI-6 will have to go through in its effort to beat the bad guy MagnaVex!

Following the corruption of the Evo\Core by MagnaVex, the city has been sent back to the Vectrex era! Everything is now immersed in a dark and corrupted Vectrex style. LAI-6 will then have to navigate through the city to find the device and the components to repair the Evo\Core to progress to the next visual era!

You will be able to play the level 1 when the game is released for FREE on Steam on March 12, 2021! If you haven't already done so, feel free to wishlist the game to help us get referenced on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39729361/c48733cea5db2c864aa4804029064ec03fcb5b13.png[/img]

notes.title: We are on Steam !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We are a team of students working in video games at Abitibi-Témiscamingue university in Montreal and we are proud to show you the final project of our degree from a team of 19 hard-working students! 

This is Evo\Wave, a 3D platformer/Collect-A-Thon set in a video game universe in which a “boomer” AI called MagnaVex decided to reset everything and bring back the good old days of retro gaming. You will have the chance to play the young AI LAI-6, which needs to restore everything and bring back the video game console to its modern state! Find and collect the different components to progress through the different graphic periods of video games!

If you like this premise please add our FREE GAME to your wishlist and our communities to know everything about it

You can reach us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EvoWave-119526256623565
Or Twitter: https://twitter.com/EvoWaveUqat
